name: Mercury
summary: The smallest planet and the closest to the Sun. It has almost no atmosphere, so it swings from scorching days to freezing nights.

name: Venus
summary: The hottest planet, wrapped in thick carbon dioxide clouds that trap heat. It spins backwards compared to most planets.

name: Earth
summary: Our home and the only place known to have life, with liquid water covering about 70% of its surface.

name: Mars
summary: The red planet, colored by iron oxide dust. It has the tallest volcano in the solar system, Olympus Mons.

name: Jupiter
summary: The largest planet, a gas giant with the Great Red Spot, a storm bigger than Earth.

name: Saturn
summary: Famous for its bright rings of ice and rock. It is so light for its size that it would float in water.

name: Uranus
summary: An ice giant tipped on its side, so it rolls around the Sun. Methane in its atmosphere gives it a blue-green color.

name: Neptune
summary: The farthest planet, with the fastest winds in the solar system. It was found by math before anyone saw it.

name: Pluto
summary: Reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006 because it has not cleared its orbit of other objects. It has a heart-shaped glacier.
